title: A study on the secondary structure of the metalloregulatory protein CueR: effect of pH, metal ions and DNA.
authors: Balogh, Ria K; Nemeth, Eszter; Jones, Nykola C; Hoffmann, Soren Vronning; Jancso, Attila; Gyurcsik, Bela
one_liner_zh: 该文用圆二色谱结合CpHMD模拟研究金属调控蛋白CueR的二级结构对pH、金属离子和DNA的响应，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但未聚焦TF-DNA结合位点或界面建模，方法以实验为主、模拟为辅，可为本课题提供蛋白-DNA结合构象变化的物理化学背景参考。
abstract: The response of CueR towards environmental changes in solution was investigated. CueR is a bacterial metal ion selective transcriptional metalloregulator protein, which controls the concentration of copper ions in the cell. Although several articles have been devoted to the discussion of the structural and functional features of this protein, CueR has not previously been extensively characterized in solution. Here, we studied the effect of change in pH, temperature, and the presence of specific or non-specific binding partners on the secondary structure of CueR with circular dichroism (CD) spectroscopy. A rather peculiar reversible pH-dependent secondary structure transformation was observed, elucidated and supplemented with pK(a) estimation by PROPKA and CpHMD simulations suggesting an important role of His(76) and His(94) in this process. CD experiments revealed that the presence of DNA prevents this structural switch, suggesting that DNA locks CueR in the alpha-helical-rich form. In contrast to the non-cognate metal ions Hg(II), Cd(II) and Zn(II), the presence of the cognate Ag(I) ion affects the secondary structure of CueR, most probably by stabilizing the metal ion and DNA-binding domains of the protein.
abstract_zh: 研究了CueR在溶液中对环境变化的响应。CueR是一种细菌金属离子选择性转录金属调控蛋白，控制细胞内铜离子的浓度。尽管已有若干文章讨论该蛋白的结构和功能特征，但CueR此前尚未在溶液中被广泛表征。在此，我们通过圆二色 (circular dichroism, CD) 光谱研究了pH、温度变化以及特异性或非特异性结合伴侣的存在对CueR二级结构的影响。观察到一种相当特殊的可逆pH依赖性二级结构转变，并通过PROPKA和CpHMD模拟进行了阐明和补充，估算出pK(a)值，表明His(76)和His(94)在此过程中发挥重要作用。CD实验揭示，DNA的存在阻止了这种结构转换，表明DNA将CueR锁定在富含α-螺旋的形式中。与非同源金属离子Hg(II)、Cd(II)和Zn(II)相比，同源Ag(I)离子的存在影响CueR的二级结构，最可能通过稳定蛋白的金属离子和DNA结合域来实现。
